title: Physics-Informed Darcian Correction Representation
objective: Test a constrained residual representation around the current MFP homogeneous face closure so known Darcy identities are exact by construction while the strong-gradient Darcian correction is retained at bounded O(1) runtime cost.

candidate_hypothesis.heterogeneous_faces: retain current LayeredMFP equal-flux interface closure in this workunit
candidate_hypothesis.homogeneous_faces: q_candidate = q_MFP + interpolated_Delta_q(h_upper, gradient), where Delta_q is generated offline from q_Darcy_oracle - q_MFP
candidate_hypothesis.coordinates: upper pressure head and dimensionless pressure-head gradient g=(h_lower-h_upper)/face_distance
constraint_columns: g=0 -> Delta_q=0, preserving equal-head gravity flow q=K(h)
candidate_hypothesis.runtime_fallback: none; coverage miss is explicit failure

required_tests: face-level direct-Darcy validation across sand and clay and multiple geometry classes
continuity and finite-difference local response diagnostics
